decisions.decision: Treat repetition and intensity as different meanings under general 3.1.22 eligibility; base-level lexical eligibility remains required.
For movement-denoting meanings governed by 3.1.23, use crooked movement instead of the two general 3.1.22 meanings.
For meanings governed by 3.1.24, use disparagement of the action instead of the two general 3.1.22 meanings.
Apply established anabhidhana exclusions before admitting a derived word-meaning.
Treat a licensed yaN-luk formation as a separate derived verbal word that inherits the corresponding yaN meaning; luk supplies no additional meaning multiplier.
